The lead section carries an unbroken run of annual amount-update notices in Yalkut HaPirsumim from י״פ תשע״ג, 1941 through י״פ תשפ״ו, 3641 — fourteen consecutive years, which is itself good evidence the Law is live and administered. Two official corroborating sources could not be read: the Knesset database page for item 2001417 returned an empty body (JavaScript application), and the Civil Aviation Authority page https://www.gov.il/he/pages/aviation-services-law returned HTTP 403 Forbidden and was not worked around.
notes: The strongest passenger-compensation statute in the corpus, and structurally close to EU Regulation 261/2004 but not identical. Encoding notes. FIRST SCHEDULE (תוספת ראשונה): flat cash compensation in three flight-distance bands — up to 2,000 km, up to 4,500 km, and over 4,500 km — with enacted base amounts of NIS 1,250 / 2,000 / 3,000. These are NOT constants: the Law indexes them, updating on 1 January each year by the ratio of the consumer price index and rounding to the nearest NIS 10, and the update is published as a Yalkut HaPirsumim notice. The figures the consolidation shows as current for 2026 are NIS 1,530 / 2,450 / 3,670, per the notice at י״פ תשפ״ו, 3641. A HUMAN MUST CONFIRM those three current-year figures against the official Yalkut notice or the Civil Aviation Authority before they are relied on, because the CAA's own page was 403 and the figures above come only from the unofficial consolidation. Model the schedule as an indexed table keyed by effective year, not as three literals. SECOND SCHEDULE: downgrade compensation expressed as percentages of the ticket price (roughly 60%-100%, varying by cabin-class change and distance). THIRD SCHEDULE: imputed ticket prices for package tours, across the same three distance bands and three service classes (the 2026 top figure shown is NIS 15,300), also indexed. Separately, s 9א, added by ס״ח תשפ״ה, 304, empowers the Minister to modify entitlements during a declared state of emergency lasting more than 14 days — a live derogation power that any faithful encoding has to represent, and the 5780/5781 amendments were the COVID-era analogue. Do not treat this Law as a translation of EU 261: bands, amounts, the assistance duties and the emergency derogation all differ.
